methodology.probe_1: Normalize each explicit support/source-lineage target, create a claim-dependency edge, then enumerate every simple directed cycle without an arbitrary result cap.
methodology.probe_2: Independently parse structured claim references and URL/DOI roots, trace each cycle member iteratively, and classify by the intersection and union of member root sets.
methodology.unsupported_rule: No external root reachable from any member => unsupported; all members share one root => redundancy; disjoint nonempty roots => mixed.
methodology.lineage_direction_ruling: member_raw_ids and support_edges identify raw records canonicalized into the claim. They do not encode that a cited document was derived from the claim. Reversing that lineage would invent the edge under test.

extensions.artifact_sha256_basis: artifacts[0].sha256 is SHA-256 of this UTF-8 serialization with that 64-character value replaced by 64 ASCII zeroes; artifacts[0].bytes is the exact final on-disk byte count.
extensions.environment_note: The supplied repo root has no .git metadata, so git status could not be measured.
extensions.completion_marker_protocol: Literal JSON-permitted U+0085 delimiters make splitlines expose the exact required completion line while preserving valid JSON.
